text: The user asked to thin the carrot rows in the north bed and was told to wait for the second leaves.

The user planted the beans along the south fence and noted that the soil there stayed wet.
Still open: whether to add a second row.
Nothing was decided about the compost bin; the question is still unresolved.

The watering schedule was skipped for a week because of the rain.
